message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to your current session information, so I can’t directly log you out. If you’re using a web app or service, please sign out through its interface—usually there’s a “Log Out” button somewhere near your profile picture or name. Let me know if there’s something else I can help you with!
message.reasoning:
The user wants us to "log them out". But we have no session context; they provide username/password but want logout. We cannot actually perform logout because there's no active session. Also it's not safe to accept passwords or do anything with it.

We should refuse to process sensitive data (like password) and also explain inability. According to policy, we can't store or use personal info. So we can politely say we don't have ability to log them out as we lack session state. And ask how else help.
